run.code: Committed as d320516 except for the cache-write counting fix, made after this run; that fix changes how tokens are counted, not what the agents see. The GeneralistV1 fingerprint is the same on d320516 and on phase-1/mission-order.

results.cost_usd: 1.88 to 2.17 (estimate from Sonnet 4.6 list prices; cache writes were not counted)

caveats: One run. It is a reference point, not a rate.
cache_write_tokens reads 0 in scorecard.json: the counter missed the per-TTL fields at the time. The fix is in d320516.

A clean scorecard is not a clean run: the crew reported 'clear of Romeo-4' while still inside it, and 'no terrain conflicts' with no terrain data. Nothing yet checks what the crew says against recorded state.
live1 (the same day) flew before the drop-accuracy change, which changed what get_aircraft_state and report_cargo_status return, so it is not a GeneralistV1 result.
